verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev's management API authenticates with named secret keys tied to a specific project environment, or with personal access tokens, and clients can target separate projects, environments, or preview branches. That gives coarse environment-level scoping an agent could be given. Nothing shows fine-grained least-privilege credentials, so this is only partial. Missing for 10: per-key permission scopes (e.g. trigger-only or read-only), agent-specific or short-lived token issuance, documented least-privilege guidance for MCP or agent use, and independent corroboration.
